title: 'Complete system reset' needed to get 440,000 young people into work, says major review
description: Alan Milburn's review will call for sweeping reforms to the education, work and welfare systems.

title: The young people caught up in Britain's Neets crisis
description: BBC News speaks to four of the million young people aged 16 to 24 who are not in work, education or training.

title: How Met failed to stop rape-unit detective who abused women
description: Warren Arter used his position - running a team investigating sexual assaults - to target women.

title: Watch: How predatory Met detective's behaviour became increasingly extreme
description: The Metropolitan Police repeatedly missed opportunities to stop det insp Warren Arter, BBC Panorama has found.

title: Ukraine accuses Russia of targeting rescue operation after 'double-tap' strike kills 72
description: Efforts to recover bodies after a “double-tap” attack in southern Ukraine are being hampered by continuing Russian strikes, officials say.

title: Cass report author says she does not support draft conversion practices bill
description: The gender care review author says the bill’s wording risks "serious unintended consequences" for parents and therapists.

title: Met Office yellow warning in place as snow could disrupt Tuesday morning travel
description: Snow could bring some transport disruption to the hills of northern England and southern Scotland, as Chris Fawkes explains.

title: Failed asylum seekers face removal without five-day notice period
description: Under proposed new rules, the Home Office would have six months in which to remove a person without telling them in advance.

title: Two major Kyiv bridges hit in Russian attack, mayor says
description: The reported strikes come a day after Ukraine launched its largest recorded drone attack on Russia since the start of the war, according to Moscow.
